member.name: T:Resto.App.Services.PaymentService
member.summary:
Handles AES-256-CBC encryption of card data and communication with the Resto.API /api/payment/process endpoint.
Security model: • Card number, expiry, and CVV are AES-256-CBC encrypted on device before any network call is made. • A fresh random 16-byte IV is generated for every transaction. • Raw card data is cleared from memory immediately after encryption. • All traffic travels over HTTPS.
